_comment: Filled M6 acceptance session for Pixelorama (https://github.com/Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama),
a 243-file GDScript-only Godot 4.x project compatible with 4.6.3. Built per
scripts/acceptance/README.md from walk.json; positions verified against the M6 OSS
acceptance walk. __PROJECT_ROOT__ / __EXTENSION_API__ are substituted by run.sh.
Targets: hover/references on `cel.on_remove()` (cel: BaseCel, cross-file via typed var),
definition on `AnimationTag` in expression position, on a preload("res://….gd") string,
and on the `Global` autoload name; documentSymbol on Project.gd (root Class + nesting);
implementation on BaseCel.get_image (4 subclass overrides); documentLink on a res:// literal.
The two extra/ rows probe autoload-singleton member typing (Global.popup_error) — landed
after M6-A..G; not validated by run.sh's required-label set but recorded in the report.
